name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola!" was returned using the OpenAI SDK with the glm-5p2 model. The only deviation from the quickstart documentation was that the model specified in the docs (accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1) returned a 404 Not Found error, so I had to query the available models endpoint and substitute a working model (accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2) to complete the quickstart.
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but this model returned a 404 Not Found error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I queried the /v1/models endpoint to discover available models and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2" to successfully complete the API call.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}

friction.where: Quickstart documentation lists a non-existent model ID
friction.detail: The first run with model accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1 fails with 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' (404 NOT_FOUND)

friction.where: Alternative model IDs from docs or guesses also 404
friction.detail: Attempts with accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct and llama-v3p1-70b-instruct both return the same openai.NotFoundError

friction.where: No documented method to discover valid models
friction.detail: The agent had to manually run 'curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models' to find a working model
